answer: A slashable stake is the bridge between cheap claims and real commitment: each agent ties one hardware-attested key to its bond, and evidence that two keys share a machine or funding burns every linked bond at once. Honest service compounds reputation toward a zenith of steady fees, while a Sybil farmer must buy a fresh bond for each fake persona and drops to the nadir the moment a single clone is linked, since slashing spreads across the whole cluster. A thousand fake agents therefore cost a thousand bonds up front, with the added risk of losing all of them together.
